verdict.rationale: AFK is built around an AI assistant that decomposes goals into tasks, pre-fills forms, and executes across integrated tools with human sign-off on writes, matching the story's delegation concept. However, all evidence is first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration, no product screenshots, and technical probes (llms.txt, openapi) returned 404s. Missing for 10: independent verification or hands-on demonstration, API/technical documentation confirming the assistant's real capabilities beyond marketing claims.
